newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico soymeal prices hit canola substitute levels.
newsitem.headline: Mexico soymeal prices hit canola substitute levels.

text.p: Mexican soymeal prices are currently high and at levels where the feed could be substituted by canola meal, the local office of the American Soybean Association (ASA) reported Monday.
"The price of beans is high and the price of meal in Mexico is reported in some cases as high as 3,000 pesos per tonne (about $375)," the ASA said in an update.

"One commerical feed manufacturer said this was the level at which canola meal can be substituted to some extent," it added, noting the high prices were also pushing up other meals, both animal and vegetable.
((--Chris Aspin, Mexico City newsroom (525) 7289530. E-mail at chris.aspin@reuters.com))
